description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin called 'editingblock' that manages editing modes, event handling, and configuration for the editing area, including source view and WYSIWYG modes.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.editor
classes.description: Prototype extension for CKEditor instances, managing modes and focus.

methods.name: addMode
methods.description: Registers a new editing mode (e.g., 'wysiwyg', 'source') for the editor.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the current editing mode of the editor, loading the appropriate mode editor.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Moves focus to the editor's editing area.
